_meta.method: Static: homepage HTML + up to 25 linked CSS files fetched with python-requests (Chrome UA), CSS custom properties, background/color/font declarations and @font-face parsed; 5 sites blocked (403) were measured rendered only. Rendered: same homepages loaded in a real browser, computed styles weighted by painted area (backgrounds) and characters (text colour, fonts). Photo style: first 5 content images per homepage downloaded and inspected as contact sheets + og:image + alt texts. Audience weight 1-3 = reach among French women 25-35 (3 = mass/very large, 1 = niche), from cited data point or estimate marked (est.).
